title: Tests use 'Contact' type_name in StateChange, masking 'ChatContact' production mismatch
description:
The events.rs test suite sends StateChange { type_name: 'Contact'.to_string() } directly (lines 898, 1394) but the production broadcast channel (kith-store/src/contact.rs line 23) sends type_name: 'ChatContact'.

Because the tests construct StateChange values in-process rather than going through the store's broadcast path, they never exercise the actual type_name values that production emits. This means:
- The TypeFilter 'Contact' vs 'ChatContact' mismatch described in the companion P0 bug (KITH-fp3n.5) is not caught by any existing test.
- Tests that use 'Contact' to close a closeafter=state stream (e.g. events_last_event_id_no_replay_when_current) work coincidentally because no type filter is active in those tests — any type_name passes through when type_filter is None.

The fix is coupled to KITH-fp3n.5: once TypeFilter is corrected to use 'ChatContact', the tests at lines 898 and 1394 must also be updated to use 'ChatContact' to remain consistent with the broadcast source.
